title: Santander: México en el radar global
summary: Noviembre vuelve a ser un mes clave para Santander en México, que reafirma la importancia del país para el grupo que encabeza Ana Botín. La columna anticipa anuncios relevantes del banco, como ocurrió en 2019 cuando México recibió al Consejo global.

title: El tema no es la deuda pública, son los ingresos
summary: La columna sostiene que el principal problema de las finanzas públicas no es la deuda —que alcanzará su máximo histórico y motivó la baja de calificación de Moody's en mayo— sino la debilidad de los ingresos. Propone matizar el diagnóstico dominante entre analistas.

title: Zurich Says Revenue Gain on Beazley Deal to Reach $1.5 Billion
summary: Zurich Insurance expects about $1.5 billion in additional annual revenue over the medium term from integrating Beazley, the specialty insurer it bought earlier this year.

title: Mark Walter’s Insurer Seeks Nod to Swap $1.2 Billion More Assets
summary: Mark Walter's biggest life insurer is seeking regulatory approval to swap an additional $1.2 billion of affiliated assets with holdings from his investment firm. It faces pressure to unwind lending to other parts of his business empire.

title: ‘Katastrophe’: inside the chaos at Germany’s biggest bank
summary: An FT investigation based on millions of leaked documents describes chaos inside Germany's biggest bank. It scrutinizes Christian Sewing's leadership of the scandal-hit lender.

title: Leak of 15mn Deutsche Bank files exposes systemic failures
summary: A leak of 15 million Deutsche Bank files — emails, internal probes and other documents — exposes systemic failures at the lender. The documents shed new light on CEO Christian Sewing's career and leadership.

title: “El nudge no basta”
summary: La columna reseña el Encuentro 2026 de la AMAFORE sobre pensiones, inversiones de las afores, longevidad y ahorro voluntario. Su tesis: los 'nudges' de economía conductual no bastan para elevar el ahorro para el retiro.

title: NBIM, GIC, BlackRock Said to Invest in Bajaj Finance Share Sale
summary: NBIM, GIC, BlackRock, Fidelity and Capital Group bought into Bajaj Finance's 117 billion-rupee ($1.2 billion) institutional share offering, according to people familiar. It signals strong global appetite for consumer-lending franchises in emerging markets.

title: Nubank podrá ejercer como banco en Brasil
summary: Nubank recibió la aprobación del Banco Central de Brasil para adquirir el Banco Porto Real de Investimentos, con lo que obtendrá licencia bancaria en su principal mercado, donde atiende a más de 120 millones de clientes. La fintech prevé cerrar la transacción en los próximos días.

title: Tech sell-off deepens as Nvidia results loom
summary: The tech sell-off deepened ahead of Nvidia's results. Investors are worried about tighter US chip export controls and a potential slowdown in AI data-centre build-out.

title: Banks seek to curb AI debt exposure as backlash mounts
summary: Lenders are offloading debt tied to data centres and chips as public opposition threatens to derail mega-projects. Banks are actively seeking to reduce their exposure to AI-related credit.

title: Baidu’s Robin Li Says AI Needs Monetization to Avoid Bubble Risk
summary: Baidu chief Robin Li says AI urgently needs better monetization if heavy investment in the technology is to pay off and avoid bubble risk.

title: Anthropic Frenzy Echoes Dot-Com Bubble, AustralianSuper CIO Says
summary: AustralianSuper, Australia's largest pension fund, questioned the valuation Anthropic is targeting in its IPO, comparing the frenzy to the dot-com bubble. The remarks signal institutional skepticism toward what could be the biggest listing ever.

title: China AI Star Sinks 85% From Peak as Chip Fears Hit Model Makers
summary: Chinese model developer Z.AI has sunk 85% from its peak as chip fears hit model makers. The reversal exposes vulnerabilities facing China's AI upstarts.

title: Pimco Says AI Bond Spreads May Tighten as Data Center Boom Slows
summary: Pimco says spreads on bonds financing the AI build-out may tighten as slower data-center construction curbs issuance. That could ease pressure a flood of AI-linked debt has put on credit markets.

title: Big Take: All Eyes on Anthropic’s IPO
summary: Anthropic's IPO this week is being watched as a bellwether for rivals like OpenAI and for the AI industry's overall health. It comes in the wake of the Nvidia scandal that has shaken AI sentiment.

title: Anthropic Faces a Longer Wait Than SpaceX to Join Stock Indexes
summary: Anthropic's IPO could generate billions in demand from index-tracking funds. However, the AI startup may have to wait longer than SpaceX did to join two major stock benchmarks.

title: China’s Top AI Firms Limit Cyber Capabilities in Latest Models
summary: China's top AI developers are releasing advanced models with reduced offensive cyber capabilities. The move follows a government proposal to ban exporting such technology.

title: HSBC Sold $300 Million Troubled Data Center Loan at Discount
summary: HSBC sold a roughly $300 million piece of a loan for a troubled New Mexico data center at a steep discount. The sale underscores deepening anxiety around AI-infrastructure lending.

title: Kalshi to Offer Stock Trading After Buying Brokerage
summary: Kalshi is preparing to offer stock and ETF trading on its app after acquiring brokerage FB Securities. The prediction-market company is expanding into broader retail investing.

title: Usuarios reportan fallas en las aplicaciones de los principales bancos de EU
summary: Usuarios reportaron fallas en las aplicaciones de los principales bancos de Estados Unidos. El incidente subraya el riesgo operativo de los canales digitales bancarios.

title: Microsoft Bug Undetected Since July Triggered Worldwide Outage
summary: The bug behind last week's worldwide outage of Microsoft productivity software had been lurking undetected in its data centers since July. The incident highlights operational and concentration risk in cloud dependencies.

title: Morgan Stanley rebaja a Brasil y revela sus apuestas en América Latina para 2027
summary: Morgan Stanley rebajó su recomendación sobre Brasil a infraponderar por riesgos fiscales y perspectivas de utilidades, mientras mantiene neutral a México. Para 2027 favorece mercados andinos como Chile y Perú.

title: Pinhal House / Cornetta Arquitetura
summary: Casa Pinhal, by Cornetta Arquitetura, sits in Santo Antônio do Pinhal in the heart of Brazil's Mantiqueira Mountains. The project pairs architectural ambition with landscape conservation.

title: Bartleby newsletter: Why you weren’t invited to that meeting
summary: The Economist's Bartleby columnist makes the case for skip-level meetings. They help leaders hear directly from employees beyond their immediate reports.

title: Alerta FMI que México mina credibilidad fiscal
summary: El FMI alertó que las rigideces del gasto y el debilitamiento fiscal minan la credibilidad de México y elevan el riesgo de endeudamiento.

title: Dólar en 2027: ING anticipa una caída del 5% y advierte por la Fed y los riesgos de una crisis de IA
summary: ING anticipa que el dólar retomará su tendencia bajista en 2027, con una caída de alrededor de 5%. Advierte que una crisis bursátil ligada a la inteligencia artificial y la Fed podrían provocar episodios de volatilidad.

title: Villa Nabu / Alexis Dornier
summary: Villa Nabu is a private retreat by Alexis Dornier in the coastal Tampah Hills of South Lombok. It applies his sculptural tropical modernism while drawing on local vernacular and landscape cues.

title: Anthropic’s giant IPO puts the heat on OpenAI
summary: The Economist argues Anthropic's giant IPO raises pressure on OpenAI. Coding agents have become big business, but the open question is what drives the next leg of growth.

title: Cuánto cuesta el Huawei Watch D3, el reloj que monitorea la presión arterial con grado médico
summary: El Huawei Watch D3 busca ser un asistente de salud de grado médico: incorpora una bolsa de aire en la correa para medir la presión arterial como un baumanómetro. Anticipa el rumbo de los wearables de salud.
